post.title: Linear Clone for XO Data
post.hook: A Linear lookalike with no database: its backend is the files agents write to disk.
post.summary: A Linear-style dark, dense issue tracker built with Next.js 16 that mirrors XO's on-disk todo and work-item files as issues. Sprints, OKRs and the wiki stay local to the browser, and v0.2 added a replay link from an issue to its agent session.
post.writeup:
## What it is
A Linear-style project tracker: issues, OKRs, sprints, calendar, members and an internal wiki, in Linear's dark, keyboard-driven UI. Keyboard shortcuts are `C` for a new issue and `Cmd/Ctrl K` for the command palette.

## Why it was made
It is meant as the visualizer for XO data: a simple dashboard over `.xo` project data plus a small work-item tool. The PRD frames it as the Linear-grade front end over the same data that the xo-space control plane owns.

## How it works
There is no database. A server-only reader scans the XO root and selected project folders, then maps `todos.json` to issues labelled "Agent todo" and `work-items.json` to issues labelled "Work item". Owners become members and folders become projects. The app never writes to those files.

The zustand store has two kinds of slices. Mirror slices (issues, members, labels, projects) reload from `/api/xo/snapshot` on every page load. Local slices (sprints, OKRs, wiki, config) persist to localStorage. Every mutation is a named action, so a real write-back API can later replace the action bodies without touching feature UI.

The XO root resolves in this order: the Setup dialog, then the `XO_ROOT` env var, then the topmost ancestor containing `.xo`. Clerk auth is optional, and the app runs in open mode without keys.

## Discipline
The docs set hard rules: kebab-case files, thin routes, token classes instead of raw hex, rows 40px tall, 13px default text, and no em dashes anywhere.

## Status
v0.1 shipped on 2026-08-11 with the XO mirror, Setup, a project tree and a mermaid wiki. v0.2 shipped on 2026-08-16 with an origin panel and a Watch replay link that opens the matching session in space-walk.

## Open questions
Write-back is still unbuilt, and so is Clerk-to-member mapping. The inbox is only a placeholder.
